description: This file contains command-line interface (CLI) commands related to managing models within a client-server application. It includes functions for listing, adding, deleting, retrieving, updating, importing, and displaying information about models. It uses Click for CLI handling, Rich for output formatting, and interacts with a 'Client' class to perform operations on models. The code defines several data structures, formatting helpers, and command implementations for model management tasks.

classes.name: ModelYamlInfo
classes.description: Data class representing model information extracted from a YAML configuration file, including model name, parameters, info, ID, access groups, and provider.

methods.name: ModelYamlInfo _get_model_info_obj_from_yaml(model: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts model information from a model dictionary loaded from YAML and returns it as a ModelYamlInfo object.

methods.name: str format_iso_datetime_str(iso_datetime_str: Optional[str])
methods.description: Converts an ISO datetime string to a human-readable format. Returns empty string if input is invalid or None.

methods.name: str format_timestamp(timestamp: Optional[int])
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp (int) to a human-readable date string. Returns empty string if input is None or invalid.

methods.name: str format_cost_per_1k_tokens(cost: Optional[float])
methods.description: Formats a cost value (float or string) to a string representing cost per 1000 tokens. Returns empty string if input is None or invalid.

methods.name: Client create_client(ctx: click.Context)
methods.description: Creates and returns a Client instance using the context's configuration.

methods.name: None list_models(ctx: click.Context, output_format: Literal["table", "json"])
methods.description: Lists all available models either as JSON or as a formatted table.

methods.name: None add_model(ctx: click.Context, model_name: str, param: tuple[str, ...], info: tuple[str, ...])
methods.description: Adds a new model to the proxy with specified parameters and info.

methods.name: None delete_model(ctx: click.Context, model_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a model given its ID from the proxy.

methods.name: None get_model(ctx: click.Context, model_id: Optional[str], model_name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific model by ID or name.

methods.name: None get_models_info(ctx: click.Context, output_format: Literal["table", "json"], columns: str)
methods.description: Displays detailed info about all models in either JSON or table format, with customizable columns.

methods.name: None update_model(ctx: click.Context, model_id: str, param: tuple[str, ...], info: tuple[str, ...])
methods.description: Updates an existing model's parameters and info.

methods.name: _filter_model(model, model_regex, access_group_regex)
methods.description: Helper to filter models based on name/ID regex and access group regex.

methods.name: _print_models_table(added_models: list[ModelYamlInfo], table_title: str)
methods.description: Outputs a table of models with name, id, and access groups.

methods.name: _print_summary_table(provider_counts)
methods.description: Outputs a summary table of provider counts.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] get_model_list_from_yaml_file(yaml_file: str)
methods.description: Loads and validates a YAML file containing a list of models.

methods.name: _get_filtered_model_list(model_list, only_models_matching_regex, only_access_groups_matching_regex)
methods.description: Filters a list of models based on regex patterns for models and access groups.

methods.name: str _import_models_get_table_title(dry_run: bool)
methods.description: Returns the appropriate table title depending on whether a dry run is performed.

methods.name: None import_models( ctx: click.Context, yaml_file: str, dry_run: bool, only_models_matching_regex: Optional[str], only_access_groups_matching_regex: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Imports models defined in a YAML file into the proxy, with support for filtering and dry-run mode.

methods.name: str access_groups_str(self)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
